page.intro: Explore official photos, videos, and press coverage from the Coast Guard Global Summit — from the inaugural gathering in Tokyo (2017) to the record-breaking 4th edition in Rome (2025), and the road to Chennai 2027.

sources.name: CGGS Official Website
sources.description: Japan Coast Guard Secretariat — events archive and official summit imagery

sources.name: Japan Coast Guard Press Releases
sources.description: Official photo galleries and summaries from CGGS summits

videos.title: Coast Guard Global Summit — Official Overview
videos.description: Official CGGS channel overview of the Coast Guard Global Summit platform and its mission of international maritime cooperation.

videos.title: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni at the 4th CGGS, Rome 2025
videos.description: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni addresses heads of coast guards from 99 countries at the 4th Coast Guard Global Summit in Rome — the first CGGS hosted outside Japan.

videos.title: India at the Coast Guard Global Summit, Rome
videos.description: Coverage of India's participation at the 4th CGGS in Rome, where India was confirmed as host of the 5th edition in 2027.

videos.title: India to Host 5th CGGS in Chennai, 2027
videos.description: News coverage announcing India's presidency and Chennai as host city for the landmark 5th Coast Guard Global Summit.

videos.title: 5th Coast Guard Global Summit 2027 — India Preview
videos.description: Overview of the upcoming 5th CGGS in Chennai, coinciding with the Indian Coast Guard Golden Jubilee.
